content: Yesuji komegone pakereya.
Sabat kombaŋ ŋebi tariko oo Maria Magdalane, Maria Jeims maŋgoine eru Salome yoŋoji “Yesure qoŋgbuŋ raru rau tekimiŋ,” miku juŋ jinaŋ kouineke furiine babuŋ.
Baru peku Sonda kae fufurere akoŋ pakereru kae fufurere wegi jojiriŋ wapeko jiŋoruŋgo rabuŋ.
Raru mimane eku mibuŋ, “Jiŋoruŋ mauineo ko yasogo pega, oi moji igogaiŋ?”
Oŋu miku pibi rako ŋonebuŋ: Ko yasogo yobu oi igogabi raru peya.
Jiŋoruŋgo ko mauine oŋu aŋgaru dimako maŋineo ropebuŋ. Ropebi furoyaŋuŋ obe ŋi jeŋoŋ mo marikuine joroine yagaŋine ŋeko ŋonebuŋ. Oŋu ŋoneru kokoine popurebuŋ.
Popurebuŋyoŋ, iŋi yajiya, “Ŋoŋo kokoi so maneniŋ. Ŋoŋo Nazaret ŋi Yesure baagobi. Iŋo maripoŋgo qabuŋyoŋ, iŋoji gboreru pakereye. Ore eru yo so pega. Ŋoneniŋ! Pepeine yo, oo ruabi peya.
Ore eru bio raru Pita eru kiŋariŋpuine sosowo biŋe iŋi yajiniŋ, ‘Iŋoji mine bayareru bonieru Galili prowinsgo raiŋ. Ŋoŋo oŋuakoŋ oo raru buŋoine miya ore so oi ŋoneinebi.’”
Oŋu yajime popureru gburugburu qaku jiŋaruŋ kouŋgone wakiru giniŋgaru rabuŋ. Sombuyaŋuŋ manebuŋ ore buŋo mo so mibuŋyoŋ, buŋoyaŋuŋ mataeya. Oŋu.
Yesuji Maria Magdalane iŋoreo fukeya.
Yesuji Maria Magdalane iŋore maŋgone gemokaku 7 yobe yabeme goya. Yesuji komegone pakereru Sonda kae fufurere akoŋ rone Maria oi fuke teya.
Fuke teme ogopuineji Yesuke go waperu damaŋ oo jiŋgeŋ keku kuyobuŋ, Mariaji yoŋoreo raru biŋeine yajiya.
Yajiyayoŋ, Yesuji gboreru goko Mariaji ŋoneya, oi so manesiŋ gabuŋ. Oŋu.
Yesuji ogoyokaine yokoreo fukeya.
Ore ŋadiineo ogoyokaineji Jerusalem siti bokeru kae mogo raiŋgo kadio rabire Yesuji kamasiine kerisieru fuke yateya.
Yokoji oŋuakoŋ raru biŋeine oi ogopuine yajibuyoŋ, yoŋoji oi oŋuakoŋ so manesiŋ gabuŋ. Oŋu.
Yesuji kiŋariŋpuine fuke yareya.

Jiki kiŋariŋpuine 11 yoŋoji tumaŋgaru uqo noku ŋekabuŋ yoŋoreo oŋuakoŋ fukeya. Fukeru maŋyaŋuŋ sanaŋgaya ore kanegaru komegone pakereme ŋonebuŋ, iŋoji biŋeine yajibuŋ oi so manesiŋ gabuŋ ore oi miyareya.
Yesuji iŋi yajiya, “Ŋoŋo kantri so raru moreŋine moreŋine roregaru ŋiŋigo go ragobi ore so Bobiaŋ Biŋene mitaniŋgabi maneinebi.
Moji Anutu manesiŋ gako miti meso rau tebi maŋine kerisieiŋ, iŋoji qowirieru Sombunde biŋe fukeiŋ. Moji so manesiŋ garu qoqomuku goiŋ, Anutuji iŋore buŋo mitarime misi korure biŋe fukeiŋ.
Manesiŋ nuku gonimiŋ, oi soi bayarebe fuŋneyaŋuŋ iŋi fukeiŋ: Yoŋoji nonde tinao gemokaku yobe yabenimiŋ. Kantri goine yoŋore buŋo miku gonimiŋ.
Kobeŋ meyaŋunji bofeŋganimiŋ. Orabeŋ nombe obu ya nobi oo so bosembe yabeiŋ. Meyaŋuŋ jibe ŋiŋigo paiyaŋuŋgo ruabi fianimiŋ.” Oŋu.
Yesuji Sombuŋ kaeo ropeya.
Ofoŋ Yesuji buŋoine oŋu yajime Anutuji ogagame Sombuŋgo roperu Anuture me furoineo ŋeku goga.
Paibe gogayoŋ, kiŋariŋpuineji bokeru kae moreŋ so raru Biŋe buŋoine misaueku gobuŋ. Oŋu gokabi Ofonji yoŋoke gio baku dobe yaberu mosi qoqowirie fukeko buŋoyaŋunji sanaŋgaya. Oŋu.
